name: Microvia geometry (aspect ratio)
description: Laser-drilled microvias must be shallow enough to plate reliably: their depth-to-diameter aspect ratio must stay within the fabrication limit, and each must span a single dielectric.
what_it_measures: For every microvia, the aspect ratio = dielectric depth (from the stackup, between the spanned copper layers) / finished drill diameter, and whether it spans exactly one dielectric.
